claim:
PR title: fix(board): keep SQLite temp data in memory so the 7-day cost view loads

The cost page's 7-day view failed with `Couldn't load costs: database or disk is full`. The board runs read-only with a 16 MB tmpfs `/tmp`; SQLite spilled the ledger's sort and group temp files there and ran out. `PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY` keeps them in the process. Board vitest 314/314, `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` clean.
